criteria.criterion: With `sync.remote` pointing at an `s3://` URL and the helper absent, store init and the synchronous push path both exit non-zero with a single actionable message naming `pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]'`. The preflight raises `OptionalDependencyError` unconditionally (independent of `push_tickets_branch`'s best-effort `strict` flag), propagating through the uncaught `write_and_push` call and the `OptionalDependencyError` re-raise in `push_after_commit`.
With the helper present but below `0.3.2`, the same paths fail closed naming the `>=0.3.2` minimum. Verified by the too-old edge oracle.
An `s3+zip://` `sync.remote` is treated as S3 mode and fails closed identically when the helper is absent. Verified by the `s3+zip://` edge oracle.

With a non-`s3://`/`s3+zip://` `sync.remote`, the preflight is a no-op: init and push succeed with no helper installed and no behavior change; and a remote whose URL cannot be resolved keeps the existing best-effort `remote-not-found` skip (it is not misread as S3). Verified by the no-regression and unresolvable-remote oracles.

S3 mode is detected purely from the remote URL scheme (no new config key added) and no new remote-URL resolution seam is introduced — the existing `_git ... remote get-url` at `push.py:418` and init.py's `_git` are reused. Verified by inspection and by the config schema being unchanged in this story.
